hypothesis: The remaining post-#2921/#2925 packed-storage retention is the per-span records themselves: 20-byte records (offset u32 + len u32 + inline 12-byte Style) where the offset is structurally derivable (the blob is contiguous: a row's spans read as running lengths from the row's own blob offset) and the style repeats (renderer-palette-bounded; the census measured at most 6 distinct styles per entry). Storing (len u32, style-id u32) 8-byte records + a per-pack style table + a RowStart{offset,first} row index should cut the retained records ~40% of the packed total (census-projected -7.55MB at the 10MiB walk tail) with byte-identical output on every path (the range-expansion oracle is the proof instrument; the per-span SGR merge-rejection stands untouched).
approach: (1) CENSUS FIRST (probe-only build lane/hillclimb-tui-scroll-probe2, tip e6e7a26e4 + #2925): packed-aware census on the canonical fixtures (10MiB dadaecfc, 2MiB d12e7daa, 40MiB 85be402f; PA_TUI_CENSUS_FILE kick phases ready/idle20/pgup100/topwalk800/topwalk2600/tail/idle_final/idle_final_trim; probe binary sha 07bbb78ec... (ii) TRANSIENTS (class a honest negative): uncacheable (unc) visits/rows/spans = 0 across ALL walk phases on ALL THREE fixtures (a settled replay never exercises the streaming path; transcript-tail renders are 0-row; splash renders only on 2MiB walks); zero retained mass, zero churn -> no product change (the uncacheable EntryRows::Fresh path stays frozen; packing it would add per-frame cost on the streaming path for zero retention benefit). Mechanism: replay-time heap interleaving (chat-tree growth between per-frame streaming renders leaves live chunks interleaved with the per-frame transients' holes; malloc_trim returns only the top) - an allocator artifact outside the storage change's reach; ABBA 6+6 trials measure the distribution.
